messages:
tia: Quick follow-up on the onboarding RFC: propose separating microbenching from functional checks. Keep fast-accept for manifest + tokenizer + tiny decode.

omar: +1. Microbench should be async and write to telemetry; do not block publish.

viv: Need clear failure modes: flag vs auto-disable. I vote for flag + degraded routing to stable model by default.

sam: Ops note: add sampling policy to limit cost (first upload + sampled thereafter). Also include an idempotency_key in job payload.

admit-bot: Created ADM-1620: onboarding microbench async job, descriptor hint fields, and rollback playbook.

tia: I'll PR descriptor changes (compat_hints, sampling_policy) today; @omar can prototype worker.
